newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine C. Bank says peso normalising.
newsitem.headline: Philippine C. Bank says peso normalising.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday the peso was showing signs of normalisation, and it had already started buying dollars again.
Central bank governor Gabriel Singson made the comments in a report to President Fidel Ramos.

"Foreign exchange trading at the Philippine Dealing System (PDS) as of 12:30 p.m. (0430 GMT) today continued to show signs of normalisation," Ramos, quoting the central bank report, said in a televised press conference.
"The central bank has so far sold today $4 million to the PDS, but we also bought $1 million," the report said.
The PDS is the computerised peso-dollar trading system among banks.
